title: Privacy: a cloud erase whose engine promise rejects after the erase leaves Swift unable to tell whether it erased
evidence: Follows S49. ios/engine/cloud.ts cloudErase builds its answer after the erase (:300): view(at) or JSON.stringify throwing there rejects the promise, and Swift's catch (ios/HealthRoadmap/Sync/CloudSync.swift erase) cannot tell an erase that landed from one that did not. Practically unreachable. A fix changes the engine path (the answer built so it cannot reject once erased), so it rides with build 13's bridge work, if at all. US-25 AC16h File-only for now (owner 2026-11-14): S51 rides build 13's bridge work.
